Notes: ONE NAME PER ROW, IN EITHER COLUMN. A new player is given a FIRST NAME from the left column that nobody in the game already has. When every first name is taken, he gets a first name and a SURNAME - 'Johannes Bauer' - and that pair is unique too. Add as many as you like; order does not matter.
A NAME IS KEPT FOR AS LONG AS THE PLAYER IS AT YOUR BASE. It is handed back only when he leaves the base for good (release:), so two players never share one. See src/core/name_book.gd.
Names already written in the Name column of any unit file - BasicTeam, the four Unit_Set files, Star Players - count as taken, so a recruit can never be called Gremory or Müller.
Mixed men's and women's names on purpose. Delete any you do not want.
ROUND AN: GENDER is for the FIRST NAME on this row - m or f. The first match (data/IntroSquad.csv) picks a man's or a woman's name with it, so a woman gets the woman's sprite. Blank = either.
